name: Velstack
author: Sammy Fort

sections.description:
Velstack connects your WordPress site to your Velstack account.

SMS notifications for WooCommerce

  • Text customers when they place an order and whenever its status changes.
  • Alert the store owner by SMS when a new order comes in.
  • Notify Dokan vendors when an order contains their products.
  • Customize every message with placeholders such as {customer_name}, {order_id}, {total} and {status}.

Chatbot

  • Add the Velstack chatbot widget to every page of your site with one switch. It uses your Velstack public key.

All settings live under the Velstack menu in your admin sidebar. WooCommerce is only needed for SMS order notifications.

External Services

This plugin connects to Velstack, a third-party service, to provide its features.

SMS API

  • What it is used for: sending SMS notifications for WooCommerce orders.
  • Data sent: the recipient’s phone number, the message text (which can include the customer’s first name, order number, order total and order status), your sender ID and your secret API key.
  • When: when an order is placed and when an order’s status changes, only for the notifications you have turned on.
  • Endpoint: https://api.velstack.com

Chatbot

  • What it is used for: showing the Velstack chat widget to your visitors.
  • Data sent: when enabled, every page loads the chatbot script from https://cdn.velstack.com/chatbot.js with your public key. Visitors’ browsers connect to Velstack to show the widget and send the messages they type.

Velstack Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New by searching for “Velstack”, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Velstack → General and enter the public and secret keys from your Velstack dashboard.
  4. Open Velstack → SMS Notifications to set your sender ID and message templates.
  5. Optionally, open Velstack → Chatbot and turn on the chatbot widget.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Velstack account?

Yes. Sign up at velstack.com to get your API keys and buy SMS credits.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Only for SMS order notifications. The chatbot works on any WordPress site.

Can I customize the SMS messages?

Yes. Every notification has its own template, and you can insert placeholders such as {customer_name} and {order_id} with one click.
